claim_boundary: DIRAC-015 completes the conditional free-Dirac continuum derivation. DIRAC-016 proves that the existing unsigned period-two cube translation exchanges the two retained rank-four copies in one coordinate direction, uniquely induces the stated four-coordinate half-shift, preserves density, and returns after two translations; it also proves that the signed incidence readout preserves each copy. DIRAC-016 does not prove that one native time update is one copy exchange, that a localized carrier moves by alternating copies, that either copy is a second physical particle, or that nature has a purpose for the doubling. The chain still does not claim uniqueness, exact finite-lattice Dirac dynamics, arbitrary nonlinear live-chi closure, electromagnetic coupling, a localized physical electron, or canonical LFM status.
